chain_words.nuance: makes small changes to fit a situation without altering the core
changes certain features of a text or style
general sense of changing something to suit a new context or audience
alters the structure and form of a text considerably
transforms a text so completely that it takes on a new character or genre

explanation: These words all describe changing a text to suit a new purpose, but with increasing transformation, from minor adjustments to a complete change of character.

usage_notes.difference: 'Adapt' keeps the identity of the original work while changing it for a new audience, whereas 'transmute' suggests a change so deep that the work takes on a new character.
